threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look bewildered trying to navigate the bus routes; locals know the best stops are never where Google says.
Caught a guy on the 35 last night arguing with his phone because it kept autocorrecting 'mate' to 'mice'. Wish I had recorded it.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The air on the weekends smells like grilled kebabs and fresh coffee from the corner cafes, a perfect mix that somehow feels like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a sidewalk dedicated to ‘scooter parking’—where electric scooters are lined up like art installations, yet somehow still get in the way.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're locals when they know that the best taco trucks are always surrounded by the smell of burnt corn tortillas.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus that suddenly stopped for a pigeon crossing the street. Driver just sighed and said, 'You gotta respect the locals.' Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always assume Gràcia is just for hipsters. They miss the quiet, hidden squares where locals actually unwind with a 'café amb llet' and a book.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still ask for the bill in Spanish at the end of a meal instead of just waiting for it. Classic rookie move.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the Overground is reliable? Wait until you're late for brunch and the trains are stuck due to a 'signal failure.'
Caught a glimpse of a bloke in a parka feeding leftover chips to a fox outside the Ritzy. The fox seemed oddly grateful.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I woke up to the sound of a wedding celebration at 3 AM, full of laughter and live music spilling into the quiet streets.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, it’s not just the clubs; locals have their own 'Kiez' parties where everyone brings a dish. Cozy and weirdly inclusive.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows the shortcut from Valencia to 24th to avoid the BART delays. Tourists just stare at their maps while we zip past.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 Mission with a busker belting opera at 16th. It felt like SF was trying to show off, even amid the chaos of delays.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the parks and squares, but it's the hidden bar in that alley that serves the best vermut that really makes it special.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they still awkwardly cart around the plastic shopping bags from El Corte Inglés, with no idea about the eco-friendly tote culture here.
